title: Staff actions

state.finished: Rejudging needs the rejudge permission on this problem. Rejecting sets the result to RJ once judging is over.
state.running: The submitter, or anyone allowed to abort, can abort it. Rejudge and reject wait until judging is over.

lock.since: The submission has been locked since {time}.

reason.sent: Sent. Waiting for the page to reload the new state.

rejudge.title: Rejudge this submission?
rejudge.body: The current result ({result}, {points}) is cleared and the submission is judged again at rejudge priority.
rejudge.label: Rejudge

reject.title: Reject this submission?
reject.body: The submission is marked rejected (RJ) and no longer scores. This works only once the judge has finished.
reject.label: Reject

abort.title: Abort judging?
abort.body: A waiting submission moves to AB at once; a running one is stopped by the judge. A finished submission does not change.
abort.label: Abort

conflict: The submission is locked, waiting for the contest's final judging, or being judged (409). The bulk rejudge has an option to include locked submissions; a single rejudge does not.

lockControl.hint: A locked submission is never rejudged, not even by a bulk rejudge (unless it includes locked ones).
